newsitem.title: USA: US stock index futures begin pit trading weaker.
newsitem.headline: US stock index futures begin pit trading weaker.

text.p: April 28 - U.S. stock index futures began pit trading weaker. Losses in U.S. T-bond futures, followthrough sales from Friday, weighed on stocks. June S&P 500s held Friday's low at 767.50. LIBOR fair value about 3.55 pts premium. Arb buy programs need 4.40 pts over cash, sells need 2.80 pts over. March U.S. new home sales seen off 2.1 pct at 794,000.
